transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, my eating has gotten all turned around lately. Some days I just forget lunch completely, and then other days I’m standing at the counter eating crackers or sweets, even though nothing really tastes right. It’s not like me, and it’s been bothering me.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
Yes… most mornings I do. I wake up with this heavy, low feeling, like the day’s already gone gray before I even get dressed. It’s been hard to shake.
Have you been enjoying things less than usual lately?

Yes, I have. I used to really look forward to my watercolor class, and the quilting circle, and book club. Lately I’ll even set my bag by the door like I’m going to go, and then I just… don’t. I can’t seem to make myself care enough to leave.
Have you lost weight without trying?

I’m not sure about weight exactly. I haven’t been trying to lose any. I just know my eating’s been off—some days I skip lunch without meaning to, and other days I’m picking at crackers or sweets, even though food doesn’t really taste good.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living?
Sometimes, yes. I don’t have any plan to hurt myself, but I do catch myself thinking… if I just didn’t wake up one morning, maybe that would be a relief to everyone.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
No, not really. I haven’t been worried about gaining weight. It’s more that my appetite just hasn’t been very normal.
Have you been sleeping more or less than usual lately?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been keeping track of it. Some nights feel different than others, but I couldn’t say for sure if it’s more or less than usual.
Have you been feeling unusually anxious or worried lately?
I’m not sure. I wouldn’t say I’ve been unusually anxious or worried… at least I haven’t really noticed it being more than normal.
Have you had less appetite than usual lately?

Yes, some days I have less appetite. My eating’s been kind of all turned around. I’ll forget lunch completely, and then other days I’ll just stand at the counter eating crackers or sweets, even though nothing really tastes right.
On the days when you find yourself eating crackers or sweets, do you feel like you’re eating more than usual?

I guess sometimes, yes, but it’s not like a real meal. It’s more like I’m just picking at crackers or sweets at the counter. Other days I forget lunch completely, so my eating is just all turned around.
Have you been feeling hungrier than usual lately?
Not really hungrier, no. It’s more that my eating is off. Some days I forget lunch altogether, and other days I end up picking at crackers or sweets, even though nothing tastes very good.
Have your clothes been fitting more loosely lately?

I haven’t really noticed my clothes being looser. What I’ve noticed more is my eating is all turned around—some days I forget lunch, and other days I’m just standing there eating crackers or sweets, even though nothing tastes right.
Have you lost any weight recently without trying?

I don’t know if I’ve lost weight, honestly. What I’ve noticed is more that my eating is all mixed up—some days I forget lunch completely, and other days I’m just standing there eating crackers or sweets even though nothing tastes right.
Have you noticed any weight loss lately?

I’m not sure about weight loss exactly. I haven’t been tracking it. It’s more that my eating has gotten all turned around—some days I forget lunch completely, and other days I’m at the counter eating crackers or sweets, even though nothing tastes right.
Compared with your usual, has your appetite decreased lately?

It’s not just decreased, exactly. It’s more like my appetite is all over the place. Some days I forget lunch completely, and other days I’m standing at the counter eating crackers or sweets, even though nothing really tastes right.
Have you lost weight recently without trying?

I don’t know for sure if I’ve lost weight. What I have noticed is my eating is really off—some days I forget lunch completely, and other days I’m just eating crackers or sweets at the counter, even though nothing tastes right.
Have you been moving or speaking more slowly than usual lately?

Yes… I think so. My body feels slowed down lately. It takes me twice as long to get across the room or button my sweater. But then sometimes I’ll pace around the house holding the same papers, not really getting anywhere.
Have you lost any weight recently without trying?

I’m not really sure about the weight itself. I haven’t been weighing myself. What I do know is my eating has gotten all turned around—some days I miss lunch without meaning to, and other days I’m just picking at crackers or sweets, even though they don’t taste like much.
Have you been having trouble concentrating lately?
Yes, I have. I’ll sit there staring at simple things, like whether I should call the pharmacy or open the mail first, and my mind just gets foggy. Then I end up doing neither.
Have you been feeling this way most days for at least two weeks?
Yes. It’s been most days, definitely longer than two weeks. It’s more like this low, colorless feeling has been hanging around for… about a year and a couple months now.
